# GitHub Actions workflows

Workflows live at the **repository root**: [`.github/workflows/`](../../.github/workflows/).

- [`ci.yml`](../../.github/workflows/ci.yml) — backend + frontend CI on push/PR
- [`pilot-gates.yml`](../../.github/workflows/pilot-gates.yml) — weekly/manual pilot validation
- [`preview-deploy.yml.example`](../../.github/workflows/preview-deploy.yml.example) — optional PR preview template

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for developer workflow and branch protection.
